POC scope (agreed): 2-week Dedicated POC running in us-west + eu-west replicas; deliverables: canary rollout plan, fallback routing, SLO telemetry board, cost delta analysis. POC goals: validate p95 <250ms with 10% traffic canaried, verify fallback to smaller quantized model under load, ensure region failover <60s.

Canary + fallback plan (notes from SE workshop):
- Canary cohort = 10% of production traffic, gradually ramp to 30% if no regressions after 24h.
- Models: primary = 7B LLM (fp16), fallback variant = quantized 4-bit 7B variant for degraded mode, cold fallback = 3B distilled model for emergency.
- Routing rules: prefer local-region Dedicated pool; fallback ladder: local 7B -> local 4-bit -> remote region 7B -> remote 4-bit -> distilled 3B.
- Rollback triggers: token error rate >1.5% OR p95 latency increase >40% vs baseline OR production-quality eval regression (BLEU/ROUGE/QA accuracy) >3pt drop on canary prompt set.
